read.thesis: Aptiv cut FY26 revenue guidance by $300M at midpoint to $12.6–12.8B on China domestic weakness (retail sales down 20%), while non-auto grew 12% and bookings reached $10B YTD; no supply-side discipline signal.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue cut $300M at midpoint
triggers.quote: We are reducing full year revenue guidance at the midpoint by $300 million

triggers.label: FY EBITDA and EPS lowered
triggers.quote: We now expect adjusted earnings per share in the range of $5.60 to $5.80.

triggers.label: Drone award $500M lifetime revenue
triggers.quote: total lifetime revenues of over $500 million over a 5-year program

guidance.quote: we now expect revenue in the range of $12.6 billion to $12.8 billion
We expect adjusted EBITDA in the range of $2.31 billion to $2.37 billion
We now expect adjusted earnings per share in the range of $5.60 to $5.80.
free cash flow is expected to be in the range of $625 million to $725 million
We have a high degree of confidence in achieving annual revenues from the robotics and drone markets of about $300 million over the next few years.
revenue of $3.12 billion to $3.22 billion with Adjusted EBITDA margins projected at 17.7%

prior_guidance_check.quote: the prior 4% to 7% growth framework into 2027 and beyond
in line with our 8% to 10% sort of framework that we've provided previously

prior_guidance_check.metric: 150bps H2 growth improvement from lapping supplier fire
prior_guidance_check.quote: the 150 basis points improvement in growth from lapping of previously identified headwinds

red_flags.label: Repeated under-conservatism on China and launch assumptions
red_flags.quote: we were not conservative enough in certain assumptions, particularly around launches and ramps

red_flags.label: Stranded costs post-spin and high decremental
red_flags.quote: offset stranded costs from the Versigent spinoff

evasions.topic: Portfolio changes / EDS or further separation
evasions.quote: I don't have any specific comments I would make at this point in time.
I won't get in specifically into 2027 at this point in time.
But right now, our revenues don't match the bookings mix over the last 2 years.
